change.before: The group met at the harbour studio to plan the spring pottery fair. They agreed to fire the test tiles on Friday, to order more clay from the usual supplier, and to ask Jonas about renting the second kiln for the weekend before the fair.
change.after: The group met at the harbour studio to plan the spring pottery fair. They agreed to fire the test tiles on Thursday, to order more clay from a new supplier in town, and to ask Jonas about renting the second kiln for the whole week before the fair.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Let's fire the test tiles on Thursday instead, Friday is the delivery day.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: And the clay — the new supplier in town is cheaper.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Ask Jonas if we can have the second kiln for the weekend before the fair.
